timeline.title: Kona joins
timeline.detail: Kona, female Red Heeler, joins Bryan’s life.

timeline.title: ICT firm founded
timeline.detail: Bryan starts his ICT business. Early operations are demanding; no invented valuation or revenue is fixed.

timeline.title: Luna joins
timeline.detail: Luna, female Pembroke Corgi, joins the household.

timeline.title: Jonathan introduces Quynh
timeline.detail: Bryan’s best friend Jonathan introduces him to his cousin Quynh (Q). Bryan and Q initially text; they do not date in person until 2023.

timeline.title: The Powerball win
timeline.detail: Bryan receives a gifted Powerball ticket and wins a $1 billion advertised jackpot. Who gifted it, the precise date, payout election, and financial execution remain open.

timeline.title: Bryan and Q date and marry
timeline.detail: They go on their first date in 2023 and marry approximately three months into dating. Exact dates and scenes are not yet set.

timeline.title: Bing and Bo join
timeline.detail: Bing, a Ragdoll cat, and Bo, a black-and-white cat, enter the household.

timeline.title: Kuma joins
timeline.detail: Kuma, male Cowboy Corgi, joins the household; exact month open.

timeline.title: Lindy hired
timeline.detail: Lindy joins as a household assistant for Bryan and Q, supporting transportation, household operations, pet care, errands and preparation for the move. Interview and personal backstory are open for play.

timeline.title: Move to Oklahoma City
timeline.detail: Bryan and Q relocate to Oklahoma City; Lindy assists with the household move. Details of the home and logistics remain open.

timeline.title: ICT and investment expansion
timeline.detail: Bryan develops his firm and investments, potentially through mergers and acquisitions. No particular acquisition, portfolio value or deal is canon until established.

timeline.title: NFL ownership pursuit
timeline.detail: Bryan pursues an NFL franchise. Seller, team, price, league approvals, terms and eventual outcome must emerge in play. The original franchise’s farewell season and potential relocation deserve full treatment.

characters.name: Bryan Luong
characters.dna: Ambitious ICT founder; business and family life develop through player decisions.
characters.starting: Founded an ICT firm in early 2022; busy with operations.
characters.guardrail: Only the user writes Bryan’s speech, actions, thoughts, choices and commitments.

characters.name: Quynh “Q”
characters.dna: Independent personality, priorities and agency; Vietnamese language and cultural background can inform natural dialogue.
characters.starting: Jonathan’s cousin, introduced by text in late 2022; first date 2023; married about three months later.
characters.guardrail: Do not portray her as Bryan’s wife before their 2023 marriage or invent how she reacts to the lottery.

characters.name: Linda “Lindy”
characters.dna: Observant, capable, organized, dry and professional with Bryan; warmer and brighter with Q over time; Iowa roots from V1 as a proposed carryover.
characters.starting: New hire, not yet a longtime confidante; initial employment covers household operations, pets, errands, transportation and move planning.
characters.guardrail: Do not import V1 relationship milestones, established closeness, accidental kiss, live-in arrangement or promotions as V2 history.

characters.name: Andy
characters.dna: Resourceful, practical, funny, hardworking, adaptable, capable of pushing back.
characters.starting: An existing worker at the acquired franchise; exact role and biography remain to be established.
characters.guardrail: Bryan has never met Andy before acquiring the team. No automatic friendship, promotion, or executive salary.

characters.name: Jonathan
characters.dna: Established best-friend relationship with Bryan; fuller personality and background to be developed.
characters.starting: Introduces Bryan to his cousin Quynh in late 2022.
characters.guardrail: Do not invent specific family history, dialogue, or involvement in the lottery.

rules: V1 and V2 are separate continuities; V1 is inspiration, not V2 history.
Only the user controls Bryan. Assistant controls other characters and world reactions.
Character DNA is not character knowledge; relationships must be earned in V2.
No automatic deals, promotions, financial outcomes, NFL approvals, relocation or game results.
2022–2025 prequel is brisk, selectively dramatized and summarized in handoffs; prioritize reaching 2026.
Preserve both hard canon and unknowns; never turn suggestions into completed events.
Create a continuity handoff at each substantial time skip and at the end of major arcs.
